name: Fy2Press Catalog for Shopify
author: Pagup

sections.description:
Bring your Shopify products to your WordPress website.

Already have a Shopify store and a WordPress site? Fy2Press connects them so you can create a product catalog, display collections and add products to your pages and blog posts.

Your visitors browse products and add them to their cart on WordPress, then complete their purchase on Shopify. You keep managing your products in Shopify.

You need a WordPress website and an existing Shopify store with its own subscription. No WooCommerce is required.

What you can do with FREE

  • Create a product catalog. Bring your Shopify products, collections and product tags into WordPress.
  • Add products to your content. Place products and collections in pages, articles and buying guides using WordPress blocks or shortcodes.
  • Help visitors find a product. Offer search, filters, sorting and pagination.
  • Choose your presentation. Customize one product design and one collection design with the included controls.
  • Offer a cart on your site. Let visitors add products in WordPress and continue to Shopify to pay.
  • Manage search visibility. Choose search indexing settings for your catalog pages.

FREE works without a paid Fy2Press licence. Full catalog updates are manual: you run synchronization to refresh the catalog saved in WordPress.

Need scheduled updates or more design options?

The separate paid PRO edition adds:

  • Scheduled catalog updates.
  • Native Elementor and WPBakery components.
  • Multiple templates.
  • Additional design controls, including settings for different devices and custom CSS.

Scheduled updates require an active PRO licence. See the FAQ for how catalog updates work.

The WordPress.org download contains FREE. PRO is sold separately.

Compare PRO features and prices

Get started with your first product page

Install Fy2Press, connect your Shopify store and follow the setup guide to bring your catalog into WordPress. New product pages are published during synchronization, so review the installation steps before starting.

Installation guide | Connect Shopify | Get help

Made by Pagup. Fy2Press is independent and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Shopify or WordPress.

External services

After configuration, Fy2Press sends HTTPS catalog/cart requests to the store’s *.myshopify.com Storefront API with its public Storefront API token, product/variant IDs, quantities and storefront context. Shopify handles checkout.

Product images keep the URLs returned by Shopify; visitors’ browsers load them from those locations on catalog pages.

Standard cart buttons collect no buyer email or phone; an integration may supply them to the cart-creation endpoint, and Fy2Press forwards them to Shopify as buyer identity only, never as telemetry or browser storage.

Cookies: fy2press_cart_ encrypts cart references (HttpOnly); script-readable fy2press_has_cart_ holds 1 to skip idle requests, with no ID, secret or authority. Both last seven days (SameSite=Lax, Secure on HTTPS). Shopify stores carts. Legacy shopipress_cart_id localStorage is migrated and removed. Checkout URLs require a checkout request. Prices use the primary Shopify market and returned currency.

Cart and design assets load with rendered Fy2Press content, including blocks and templates. The shopipress_global_cart filter enables site-wide cart access and assets.

Shopify handles this data under its Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. Fy2Press does not send usage telemetry or licensing requests to Pagup.

The Freemius WordPress SDK provides optional usage opt-in and PRO licensing, trials, secure downloads and updates. Opt-in or commercial flows send the site URL, WordPress/PHP/plugin versions, administrator account information and necessary licence/diagnostic data. The FREE functionality remains available when opt-in is skipped. See Freemius Terms and Privacy Policy.

Links to documentation and support at https://fy2press.com are ordinary external navigations initiated by the administrator. Fy2Press does not fetch documentation, fonts, scripts or styles there, or ping links. See privacy and security.

Source code

Source and locked build inputs for every minified asset built from Fy2Press code are included.

  • The Vue administration source is in admin-ui/src; its package manifest and pnpm lockfile are in admin-ui.
  • The Gutenberg editor source is in admin/page-builders/gutenberg/assets/js; its build script is admin/page-builders/gutenberg/assets/build.mjs, with the npm manifest and lockfile at the plugin root.
  • The Composer manifest and lockfile needed to regenerate the committed autoloader are at the plugin root.
  • vendor/freemius holds the Freemius WordPress SDK 2.13.4, third-party GPLv3 code distributed unmodified with its compiled scripts and styles from the official Freemius/wordpress-sdk repository.

In PowerShell: npm ci then npm run build:gutenberg (Gutenberg bundle); pnpm --dir .\admin-ui install --frozen-lockfile --config.auto-install-peers=false then pnpm --dir .\admin-ui run build (FREE administration bundle) and pnpm --dir .\admin-ui run check:bundles. The PRO package adds premium/admin-ui/src and pnpm --dir .\admin-ui run build:pro.
sections.installation:
You need a WordPress website and an existing Shopify store with its own subscription.

  1. In WordPress, open Plugins > Add New Plugin, search for Fy2Press, then install and activate Fy2Press Catalog for Shopify by Pagup. Alternatively, upload the ZIP from WordPress.org.
  2. Open Fy2Press and enter your store subdomain and public Storefront API token. Follow the Shopify connection guide. Do not use an Admin API token or a private Storefront token.
  3. Select Test Connection. Confirm that the connection is to the intended store, then save.
  4. Before synchronizing, prepare your site’s visibility: new product pages are published directly, not saved as drafts. Open Products, discover your catalog and review the result, then start manual synchronization. Search indexing settings do not make a published page private.
  5. Open Design to adjust your product and collection presentation. Use Add to my pages or Help for examples of the blocks and shortcodes you can place in your content.
  6. Check a product page, its variants and cart, and the link to Shopify checkout before sharing your catalog.

For an existing site, use a staging copy to review changes before applying them to the public catalog. The setup guides provide current instructions and troubleshooting.
sections.faq:
Is Fy2Press free?

Yes. FREE works without a paid Fy2Press licence, including when you skip the optional Freemius usage opt-in. You still need a Shopify subscription and WordPress hosting, which are separate services. PRO is a separate paid edition.

Do I need WooCommerce or a developer?

WooCommerce is not required. You can build a basic catalog with the included blocks and Design controls without writing code. Connecting Shopify requires configuration, and custom layouts or theme adjustments may need technical help.

Where do customers complete their purchase?

Customers browse and use the cart on your WordPress website, then complete their purchase through Shopify checkout. You continue to manage products and orders in Shopify. Fy2Press does not migrate orders into WordPress.

Is synchronization automatic?

In FREE, you start catalog synchronization manually. With an active PRO licence, you can schedule updates hourly, twice daily or daily. Scheduling is off by default and depends on WordPress running its scheduled tasks. It is not a continuous, real-time update service. After changing Shopify data, synchronize the saved catalog and refresh the relevant page cache when needed.

How do availability and cart updates work?

FREE and PRO check availability for displayed product variants separately from full catalog updates. The cart shows quantities confirmed by Shopify. These checks do not continuously synchronize stock or update saved product details and prices. Run full synchronization to refresh the saved catalog, and refresh page caches when needed. See the integration reference for timing and limits.

Can synchronization overwrite my changes?

Shopify remains the source for synchronized product fields, so a later synchronization can reapply product titles and page addresses. Existing WordPress product-page content is preserved by the documented behaviour, but your chosen template must display it. New product pages are published directly rather than saved as drafts. Prepare the site’s visibility before your first synchronization.

What do the SEO controls do?

You can choose indexing settings for products, collections and tags, and a preferred product address on WordPress or Shopify. Fy2Press also provides structured product information from the available data. These settings do not guarantee indexing, rankings or rich results. The SEO guide explains the options.

Can I use Elementor or WPBakery?

FREE includes 17 Gutenberg blocks and 27 shortcodes for placing products, collections and cart features in WordPress. PRO adds native Elementor and WPBakery components and more design options. The page builders are separate products with their own requirements and licences.

Will Fy2Press work with my WordPress theme?

Your theme and templates affect how the catalog looks. Check your product pages, collections and cart on desktop and mobile before launch. Developers can consult the integration reference for theme and template details.

What happens if my PRO licence is no longer active?

Scheduled synchronization returns to manual; the saved schedule is kept. FREE features remain available. If your pages use premium templates or builder components, review their fallback behaviour before changing editions.

What should I check before importing a large catalog?

There is no guaranteed capacity for every site. Hosting resources and caches can affect large catalogs. Test a representative selection of products, variants and collections before a large rollout.

Does the plugin use cookies or external services?

Yes. Shopify provides catalog and cart services and handles checkout. Fy2Press uses cart cookies, and Freemius provides optional usage opt-in and commercial features. The External services section explains what is sent, when and to whom, with links to the relevant policies.

What happens when I delete the plugin?

With Delete Settings on Uninstall enabled, an administrator must deactivate and then delete Fy2Press for its settings and caches to be removed. Synchronized content is retained. Developers using WP-CLI should follow the uninstall instructions.

Where can I get help or find developer information?

Use the setup guides or contact PAGUP support for product questions and bugs. For a confidential security report, use the security guidance and do not post secrets or exploit instructions publicly.

Developers can use the public technical reference, available in English and Canadian French. That repository contains documentation, not an installable plugin. Source locations and build commands are listed in the Source code section of the description.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Check displayed variant availability in FREE and PRO without a full catalog synchronization, using a 45-second observation cache.
  • Show Shopify-confirmed cart quantities and restrictions. Availability checks distinguish permitted out-of-stock sales and unknown quantities.
  • Keep retained zero-quantity lines readable and removable; disable checkout when the cart’s total quantity is zero.
  • Reconcile lost cart responses without automatically repeating mutations, and keep product-form feedback scoped to the current operation.
  • Update vue-i18n and its related translation components.

1.0.0

  • Connect a Shopify store with a public Storefront token and manually synchronize products, collections and tags. Catalog discovery resumes in batches; interrupted writes do not resume automatically.
  • Publish using 17 blocks, 27 public fy2press_* shortcodes, included designs and catalog SEO controls.
  • Present the cart in WordPress with Shopify cart services and checkout; administration available in nine locales.
